name: RestoSignals
description: US restaurants and bars 1-6 months before they open. Fuses public liquor-license applications, food-service permits and new-business filings into one deduplicated venue, scored 0-100 for how close it is to opening, with the owner contact from those filings. Live in NY, TX, IL, CA, OR, CO and WA. 5 read-only tools.
